employee_shift_eligibility_limits_check.name: employee_shift_eligibility_limits_check
employee_shift_eligibility_limits_check.value: ("employee_shift_eligibility"."max_per_week" is null or "employee_shift_eligibility"."max_per_week" between 0 and 7) and ("employee_shift_eligibility"."exact_per_week" is null or "employee_shift_eligibility"."exact_per_week" between 0 and 7)

employee_unavailabilities_window_check.name: employee_unavailabilities_window_check
employee_unavailabilities_window_check.value: ("employee_unavailabilities"."start_minute" is null and "employee_unavailabilities"."end_minute" is null) or ("employee_unavailabilities"."start_minute" between 0 and 1440 and "employee_unavailabilities"."end_minute" between 0 and 1440 and "employee_unavailabilities"."end_minute" > "employee_unavailabilities"."start_minute")

employees_birthday_check.name: employees_birthday_check
employees_birthday_check.value: ("employees"."birthday_month" is null and "employees"."birthday_day" is null) or ("employees"."birthday_month" between 1 and 12 and "employees"."birthday_day" between 1 and 31)

employees_dates_check.name: employees_dates_check
employees_dates_check.value: "employees"."left_on" is null or "employees"."hired_on" is null or "employees"."left_on" >= "employees"."hired_on"

scheduling_rules_scope_check.name: scheduling_rules_scope_check
scheduling_rules_scope_check.value:
("scheduling_rules"."scope" = 'global' and "scheduling_rules"."section_id" is null and "scheduling_rules"."employee_id" is null)
        or ("scheduling_rules"."scope" = 'section' and "scheduling_rules"."section_id" is not null and "scheduling_rules"."employee_id" is null)
        or ("scheduling_rules"."scope" = 'employee' and "scheduling_rules"."employee_id" is not null and "scheduling_rules"."section_id" is null)

staffing_requirements_validity_check.name: staffing_requirements_validity_check
staffing_requirements_validity_check.value: "staffing_requirements"."valid_from" is null or "staffing_requirements"."valid_to" is null or "staffing_requirements"."valid_to" >= "staffing_requirements"."valid_from"

public.shift_type_durations.definition:
select shift_type_id,
    sum(end_minute - start_minute - unpaid_break_minutes)::integer as paid_minutes,
    min(start_minute)::integer as first_start_minute,
    max(end_minute)::integer as last_end_minute
  from shift_type_periods
  group by shift_type_id
public.shift_type_durations.name: shift_type_durations
